name: Cursed Sacrifice
description: Hold block to bleed into a ritual circle that summons horrors.

displayLines.label: Max health spent on a full charge

details:
Hold block to draw a pentagram under you (you can't move or shoot while charging). Charging is a blood sacrifice: a full charge to level 3 costs 60% of your max health in total, paid as you go, and it's never given back. It can't take you below 1 health.

Let go and the charge drains back quickly, but not at once: step back in and hold block to pick it up where it is. A finished pentagram stays on the floor until the ritual is done.

Level 1: a swarm of critters pours out and hunts enemies.
Level 2: a huge brute with a big health pool climbs out and runs down enemies.
Level 3: meteors rain across the whole map (many near enemies). Each one is marked on the ground a moment before it lands, hits everyone in the blast, you included, and leaves a wide patch of fire.

Everyone nearby can hear a low hum while you charge. Charging speed comes from Block cooldown and Block duration; Block size makes the circle, swarm and meteors bigger. No block bubble.
